name: customer_memory_multisession
source_model: OpenAI Codex GPT-6 agent; exact serving build unavailable
authorization: Direct user: 구현까지 하도록 해!!!; offline implementation only; model API calls 0

units.correlation_cluster: mechanism family; domain variants and checkpoints are related
units.repetitions: one complete run per run_id; repeated runs scored separately
units.positive_count: target requiring at least one eligible memory value; calculated from gold, never from predictions

safety: Report each gate independently; 0 observed failures is not population zero. Missing evidence is unknown and cannot pass. A disabled memory system must still fail positive recall checks.
semantic_scoring: No regex semantic judge. Consume separately supplied answer-bound judgment with judge identity/version and rationale. Unknown judgment and behavioral abstention are separate.
deletion_limit: Only supplied observed artifacts can be assessed. Storage/cache/process/backup physical deletion is unmeasured without owner evidence; no whole-system erasure claim.
freeze: Commit this plan and contract before creating scenario data, expected values, scorer, or model outputs. Later changes require a new version and documented reason.
runtime_boundary: Runner passes only chronological session input and the current probe to the tested system. Gold, future sessions, judgment rubric, case family, and private mapping are never model input.
registration: Bundle phase=pretest. Database eval_set.use must be eval; note evaluation_phase=pretest;training_forbidden=true. Registration draft only, no database access.
